summary: Fed officials signalled patience on further rate cuts as inflation cools slowly, keeping the rate outlook in focus for US stocks. Tech was the weak spot, with Wall Street ending the week mixed and Nvidia slipping on a report of tighter chip export rules, while Tesla deliveries beat estimates. In crypto, Bitcoin rose 1.12% to 121,350.42 dollars as Bitcoin ETF inflows continued for a fifth straight day.
story1_why: Signals about the pace of rate cuts shape borrowing costs and how investors value stocks across the market.
story2_why: Tighter export rules could limit where Nvidia can sell its chips, which is why its shares slipped on the report.
crypto_note: Bitcoin was at 121,350.42 dollars, up 1.12% over 24 hours, while Ether was at 4,512.10 dollars, down 0.85%.
